segments.text: This is the seventh video presentation for the Case Animal and Plant Biotechnology course.
segments.zh: 这是 CASE 动物与植物生物技术课程的第七个视频讲解。

segments.text: As you view this video, be sure to make notes of important information.
segments.zh: 观看本视频时，请务必记下重要信息。

segments.text: Feel free to pause, repeat, and resume the video whenever necessary.
segments.zh: 必要时可以随时暂停、重播和继续播放视频。

segments.text: A Bioscience Way of Life, Lesson 4.4, Everyday Biotechnology
segments.zh: 生物科学的生活方式　第 4.4 课　日常生物技术

segments.text: You completed Lesson 4.3, Animal Applications, during which you performed ELISA tests,
segments.zh: 你已经完成了第 4.3 课“动物应用”，其间你做了 ELISA 检测，

segments.text: completed a marker-assisted selection simulation, and discussed disease diagnoses and genetic abnormalities.
segments.zh: 完成了标记辅助选择的模拟，并讨论了疾病诊断和遗传异常。

segments.text: This presentation provides information about how biotechnology is used in other aspects of everyday life.
segments.zh: 本讲解介绍生物技术如何应用于日常生活的其他方面。

segments.text: First, consider everything you have done since waking up this morning.
segments.zh: 首先，想一想你从今天早上醒来到现在做过的所有事情。

segments.text: Pause the video and write a short list of activities you have taken part in so far today.
segments.zh: 暂停视频，简短列出你今天到目前为止参与过的活动。

segments.text: Resume the video to reveal a short list of everyday products produced through biotechnology applications.
segments.zh: 继续播放视频，查看一份通过生物技术应用生产的日常产品的简短清单。

segments.text: As you look at this list, do you see any items on your list? Have you eaten, worn, or been transported by a product of biotechnology?
segments.zh: 看着这份清单，你的清单上有没有其中的项目？你有没有吃过、穿过生物技术产品，或者乘坐过借助生物技术产品运行的交通工具？

segments.text: Did you list any additional biotechnology applications?
segments.zh: 你有没有列出其他的生物技术应用？

segments.text: Dietary energy availability is shown in the map here.
segments.zh: 这张地图显示了膳食能量的供应情况。

segments.text: Across the globe, dietary energy, nutrient availability, and malnutrition are the greatest health problems.
segments.zh: 在全球范围内，膳食能量、营养供应和营养不良是最大的健康问题。

segments.text: According to the World Food Program, improper nutrition is more prevalent than any single disease.
segments.zh: 根据世界粮食计划署的说法，营养不当比任何一种单一疾病都更普遍。

segments.text: Improper diet is caused by many factors, some more manageable than others.
segments.zh: 饮食不当由许多因素造成，其中有些因素比其他因素更容易控制。

segments.text: How can biotechnology contribute to the solution?
segments.zh: 生物技术能为解决这个问题做出什么贡献？

segments.text: Pause the video to consider this question.
segments.zh: 暂停视频，思考这个问题。

segments.text: Record your thoughts in your notes. Resume the video when you are finished.
segments.zh: 把你的想法记在笔记里。完成后继续播放视频。

segments.text: Be ready to discuss the potential effects of current biotechnologies, as well as acceptance of GM foods with your classmates.
segments.zh: 准备好与同学讨论当前生物技术的潜在影响，以及人们对转基因食品的接受程度。

segments.text: Now think of additional methods of producing energy using biotechnology.
segments.zh: 现在想一想利用生物技术生产能源的其他方法。

segments.text: Pause the video, record any ideas you have, and resume the video when you are finished.
segments.zh: 暂停视频，记下你的想法，完成后继续播放视频。

segments.text: Bioremediation is a process that uses microorganisms to convert pollutants into safe byproducts.
segments.zh: 生物修复是一种利用微生物把污染物转化为安全副产物的过程。

segments.text: Where could bioremediation be of assistance?
segments.zh: 生物修复可以在哪些地方发挥作用？

segments.text: Biotechnology also has many uses in human health, from developing new, more targeted medicines to faster, better, and more reliable diagnostic tests.
segments.zh: 生物技术在人类健康方面也有许多用途，从开发更具针对性的新药，到更快、更好、更可靠的诊断检测。

segments.text: Organisms can even be engineered to produce medicines in a process called farming.
segments.zh: 甚至可以对生物体进行工程改造来生产药物，这个过程被称为“药物农业”。

segments.text: One such product is insulin.
segments.zh: 胰岛素就是这样的产品之一。

segments.text: More intriguing yet are the questions here. How will biotechnology change everyday life in the future?
segments.zh: 更耐人寻味的是这里的问题：生物技术将来会如何改变日常生活？

segments.text: Pause the video as you consider these questions and record your thoughts.
segments.zh: 暂停视频，思考这些问题并记下你的想法。

segments.text: As a review, mark or highlight three key points in your notes that are important to remember from this presentation.
segments.zh: 作为复习，请在笔记中标出或突出本讲解中需要记住的三个要点。

segments.text: List two ideas or concepts that relate to previous knowledge.
segments.zh: 列出两个与已有知识相关的观点或概念。

segments.text: List any questions you have about this topic. Discuss these questions with your instructor.
segments.zh: 列出你对这个主题的任何问题，并与老师讨论这些问题。

segments.text: Keep any notes you have from this presentation organized and available for use throughout the course.
segments.zh: 把本讲解的所有笔记整理好，以便在整个课程中随时使用。

segments.text: Through Project 4.4.1 Bioremediation, you will design and conduct an experiment determining the effectiveness of oil-eating microbes in various environmental conditions
segments.zh: 通过项目 4.4.1“生物修复”，你将设计并开展一项实验，测定食油微生物在各种环境条件下的效果，

segments.text: in order to understand how naturally occurring processes provide industrial applications.
segments.zh: 以理解自然发生的过程如何提供工业应用。

segments.text: Your teacher will provide more instructions and expectations for the project along with the lab report evaluation rubric.
segments.zh: 你的老师会提供关于该项目的更多说明和要求，以及实验报告的评分标准。
